arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import math
values = [6120, 5840, 5373, 5530, 4419]
# Geometric mean = (product of all values)^(1/n)
product = 1
for v in values:
    product *= v
print(f'Product: {product}')
geo_mean = product ** (1/5)
print(f'Geometric Mean: {geo_mean}')
print(f'Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(geo_mean, 2)}')
"
